legal.s3Text2: Animal photographs are taken and submitted by users. Each user retains the rights to their own photographs.
legal.s4Highlight: 🔒 Faunex never sells your personal data and never shares it for advertising purposes. Your data is only shared with providers strictly necessary for the service to run.
legal.s4Text: The full, detailed privacy policy is available here:
legal.s5Text: Faunex only uses technical cookies strictly necessary for the app to function (authentication, user session) as well as audience measurement and conversion cookies. No cookie is used to sell your data. You can delete or block cookies at any time from your browser settings.

legal.s7Title: 7. General terms of use and sale
legal.s7Intro: By creating an account or continuing to use Faunex, you accept these terms and enter into a contract with {{brand}} (Valentin Moulay). You declare that you are of legal age or have the authorization of your legal guardian.
legal.s71Text: Faunex grants you a personal, non-exclusive and non-transferable right of use within the limits of your chosen plan. In particular, the following are prohibited: any illegal use, fraud, spam, infringement of third-party intellectual property rights, publishing unlawful content or photographs of people without their consent, reverse engineering, resale or redistribution of the service, automated data extraction (scraping), and any security breach (malware, penetration testing, bypassing technical limits).
legal.s72Text1: Faunex offers a free plan (limited to 4 captures per day) and a {{premium}} subscription priced at {{monthly}} or {{yearly}} (2 months free), unlocking unlimited captures, better detection and moderation, location of nearby species, and notes on captures. legal.s72Text2: The subscription is monthly and renews automatically at each due date until cancellation. You can cancel at any time from {{settingsPath}}; cancellation takes effect at the end of the current period, with no extra fees. Prices are shown in euros; applicable taxes (VAT) are calculated and added at checkout based on your country.

legal.s72Text3: Payment, billing, tax, cancellation and refund terms are detailed in {{paddleLink}} and in our {{refundLink}} (30-day guarantee).
legal.s73Text: Our order process is handled by our online reseller Paddle.com. Paddle.com is the Merchant of Record for all our orders. Paddle handles all customer service requests as well as returns and refunds.
legal.s74Text: We may suspend or terminate access to the service, including a paid subscription, in the event of: a serious breach of these terms, non-payment, security or fraud risk, or repeated violations of our posting rules. Where reasonably possible, we will notify you beforehand. If you terminate or if we suspend for a breach, you may request an export of your data before your account is deleted.

legal.s8Final: Once the request is confirmed, deletion is irreversible. Your data is erased within {{bold}} maximum after the request.

meta.title: Privacy policy — Faunex
meta.description: Faunex privacy policy: data collected, purposes, user rights, retention and security. GDPR compliant.
meta.ogDescription: Faunex privacy policy: data collected, purposes, user rights, retention and security.

privacy.highlight: 🔒 Faunex does not sell your data. Your information is only shared with providers strictly necessary for the service to run.
privacy.s1Intro: {{brand}} is a wildlife identification and collection app, available on the web and as a mobile app, published by:
privacy.s1Outro: This privacy policy explains what data we collect, why we use it, how we protect it, and what your rights are.
privacy.s2Intro: We only collect the data necessary for the app to function:
privacy.s2Item1: Authentication data: email address, unique identifier, hashed password (never stored in plain text), and possibly name/first name provided by Google or Apple during SSO login.
privacy.s2Item2: Profile data: display name, username, profile picture (optional), bio (optional).
privacy.s2Item3: Captures and user content: animal photographs, identified species name, personal notes, date and location of the capture (if geolocation is enabled).
privacy.s2Item4: Location data: approximate or precise GPS coordinates, only if you enable geolocation and explicitly consent.
privacy.s2Item5: Technical data: device type, operating system, IP address, connection logs, push notification identifiers (if enabled).
privacy.s2Item6: Transaction data: when purchasing Faunex Premium, our reseller Paddle collects the information necessary for payment (email, country, payment method). Faunex does not store your bank details.
privacy.s3Title: 3. Purposes and legal bases of processing
privacy.s3Row1P: Creating and managing the user account
privacy.s3Row3P: Displaying public/private profile and social feed
privacy.s3Row4P: Geolocation of captures and proximity radar
privacy.s3Row5P: Sending transactional emails (confirmation, password reset, notifications)
privacy.s3Row6P: Sending reminder and tip emails (can be disabled)
privacy.s3Row10P: Managing the Premium subscription and billing
privacy.s4Item1: Faunex (Valentin Moulay) and any of its agents, solely for operating and improving the service.
privacy.s4Sub1: Lovable (web hosting via Cloudflare) — United States
privacy.s4Sub2: Supabase (database, authentication, storage) — depending on the project's region
privacy.s4Sub4: Google (SSO login, Gemini AI models for identification, analytics) — United States
privacy.s4Sub5: Apple (Sign in with Apple SSO login) — United States
privacy.s4Sub6: Paddle.com Market Ltd (payments, billing, VAT, refunds) — United Kingdom / United States
privacy.s4Item3: Other users, only for the data you choose to make public (public profile, shared captures).
privacy.s4Item4: Competent authorities, where required by law.
privacy.s4Outro: We do not sell, rent or transfer your personal data to third parties for advertising purposes.
privacy.s5Text: Some providers (Lovable, Cloudflare, Google, Apple, Paddle) may process data outside the European Union, notably in the United States and the United Kingdom. These transfers are governed by the European Commission's standard contractual clauses, adequacy decisions, or appropriate certification mechanisms.
privacy.s6Item1: Account data and active content: kept for as long as your account is active.
privacy.s6Item2: Data after account deletion: deleted or anonymized within a maximum of 30 days, unless otherwise required by law.
privacy.s6Item3: Connection logs and security data: kept for a maximum of 12 months.
privacy.s6Item4: Billing data: kept by Paddle for the applicable legal period (generally 10 years).
privacy.s7Intro: In accordance with the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR), you have the following rights:
privacy.s7Item1: Right of access: obtain a copy of your personal data.
privacy.s7Item2: Right to rectification: correct inaccurate data.
privacy.s7Item3: Right to erasure ("right to be forgotten"): request deletion of your data.
privacy.s7Item4: Right to restriction of processing: restrict the use of your data in certain cases.
privacy.s7Item5: Right to portability: receive your data in a structured format.
privacy.s7Item6: Right to object: object to certain processing, particularly for analytics purposes.
privacy.s7Item7: Right to withdraw consent: at any time for geolocation, push notifications and reminder emails.
privacy.s7Outro: To exercise your rights, send an email to {{email}}. We respond within one month. In case of dispute, you can contact the {{cnilLink}}.
privacy.s8Intro: We implement the following measures to protect your data:
privacy.s8Item3: Granular database access control (Row Level Security).
privacy.s8Item4: Monitoring, logging and detection of abnormal access.
privacy.s8Item5: Access restricted to authorized personnel only.
privacy.s9Text: Faunex uses cookies and equivalent technologies strictly necessary for the service to function (session, authentication) as well as audience measurement and conversion cookies. No cookie is used to sell your data. You can manage or block cookies from your browser settings.
privacy.s10Text: Faunex is not intended for children under 16. We do not knowingly collect personal data from children. If you believe a child has provided us with data, contact us at contact@faunex.fr so we can delete it.
privacy.s11Text: We may update this privacy policy to reflect legal or functional changes. In case of substantial changes, we will notify you beforehand. The last update date is shown at the bottom of the page.
privacy.s12Text: For any question about this policy or the protection of your data, contact us at: {{email}}.
privacy.footerDates: First published: March 8, 2026 · Last updated: August 21, 2026

meta.title: Refund policy — Faunex
meta.description: 30-day money-back guarantee on the Faunex Premium subscription. How to request a refund from Paddle, our Merchant of Record.

refund.highlight: ✅ 30-day money-back guarantee on the Faunex Premium subscription.
refund.s1Text1: If the {{premium}} subscription (€2.40/month or €24/year) doesn't suit you, you can request a full refund within {{days}} of the order date, with no need to justify your decision.
refund.s1Text2: This period also applies to each monthly renewal: a renewal can be refunded within 30 days of the charge.
refund.s2Intro: Faunex payments are processed by our reseller {{bold}}, Merchant of Record for all our orders. Paddle handles refund requests and billing questions.
refund.s2Item1: Go to {{link}} with the email address used at purchase, or use the link on your receipt.
refund.s2Item2: Or write to us at {{email}}: we'll forward your request and assist you until it's processed.
refund.s2Outro: The refund is issued to the original payment method, usually within 5 to 10 business days depending on your bank.
refund.s3Text: You can cancel your subscription at any time from {{settingsPath}}. Cancellation stops future charges; Premium access remains active until the end of the period already paid for.
refund.s3SettingsPath: Settings → Faunex Premium → Manage my subscription
refund.s4Text1: Payment, billing, tax and refund terms applied by our reseller are detailed in {{buyerTerms}} and {{refundPolicy}}.
